'''Rosset''' was a member of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] who opposed [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. He was aboard the [[Bloodfin (Star Destroyer)|''Bloodfin'']] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] and supported [[Quille]]'s coup against Pellaeon.
